lines.text: Read the room before telling that joke.

data.define: To sense the mood and act wisely.

example.text: Read the room before telling that joke.

misuse.text: Don't tell someone to 'read the room' loudly.

publish.title: What does "read the room" mean?
publish.value: Read the room = Notice how others feel. Example: "Read the room before telling that joke." (casual English, US).
